findings.title: Aggregate usage across split review parts
findings.description: Each review part gets its own usage record, but `fold_review_parts` produces one step result. The folding logic in `review_fold.py` copies metadata only from the first part, so `sq stats run` undercounts usage and cost for later parts. If the first part has no record, usage from subsequent parts is lost entirely.

findings.title: Preserve telemetry when compact fails after spending
findings.description: The SDK compact path catches failures and returns an `ActionResult` without usage metadata. This drops telemetry when the dispatch raises a `ProviderError` carrying spend, and also when summary capture succeeds but session reconnection fails. The failed action is then reported as unrecorded despite having incurred cost.

findings.title: Capture usage for prompt-only compact actions
findings.description: This path runs `claude_agent_sdk.query` but only waits for the compact boundary; it never reads result usage or stamps a usage record. Since `sq stats run` classifies compact actions as LLM actions, successful prompt-only compactions are omitted from its totals.

findings.title: Skip artifacts that cannot be read
findings.description: `read_frontmatter` can raise `OSError` while reading an artifact, but this loop only handles frontmatter parse failures returned as `None`. A single unreadable or concurrently removed file therefore aborts the entire reviews report instead of being warned about and skipped.

findings.title: Validate the frontmatter cost-basis type
findings.description: `costBasis` comes from YAML and can be a list or mapping. The set-membership check raises `TypeError` for an unhashable value, aborting the report rather than treating the malformed field as unknown and keeping the row. Check that the value is a string before testing membership.

findings.title: Add a load test for SDK usage capture
findings.description: The new reader runs on the SDK streaming path, but the existing usage-reader load test exercises the OpenAI reader, not SDK `ResultMessage` processing. The project’s load-test rule requires coverage for network paths; add a realistic SDK stream load test that checks event-loop scheduling or resource bounds.
